sloka: हर्षेण तु समाविष्ट इन्द्रजित् समितिञ्जयः ।प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां हर्षयन् सर्वराक्षसान् ।। ६.४६.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: harṣeṇa tu samāviṣṭa indrajit samitiñjayaḥ ।praviveśa purīṁ laṅkāṁ harṣayan sarvarākṣasān ।। 6.46.29 ।।।।

translations.english: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body
